page_title: MCI 1-1 LIV | Manchester City v Liverpool 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+8' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
90+8' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+8' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempts to find Jeremy Doku, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
90+5' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90+3' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Chris Kavanagh ignores the protests.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) has too much to say to the referee and is cautioned.
88' Goal disallowed! Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) scores but Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
87' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.
86' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Corner kick. Manchester City will have an opportunity.
86' Joel Matip (Liverpool) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
85' Jurgen Klopp decides to make a substitution. Darwin Nunez will be replaced by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
85' A substitution has been made. Alexis Mac Allister goes off and Wataru Endo (Liverpool) comes on.
83' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
82' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City earn a free kick.
80' 1 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Salah pulls the ball back for Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom left corner. 1:1.

80' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Alisson shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
79' Good defending. Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
78' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul. Chris Kavanagh had a clear view and blows his whistle.

76' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
75' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
73' Substitution. Dominik Szoboszlai leaves the pitch and is replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
72' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

72' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the right side of the goal. Ederson is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
70' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
68' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Chris Kavanagh due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Ruben Dias (Manchester City) and his team.
68' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) prepares to take a corner kick.
66' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
66' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Manchester City players are visibly unhappy with the call.

65' There's a break in play and referee Chris Kavanagh must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Manchester City using VAR. This could be interesting!

65' Rodri (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.

64' Phil Foden (Manchester City) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Bernardo Silva, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
63' Phil Foden (Manchester City) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

62' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
62' The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Liverpool win a corner.
61' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement.
60' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.
59' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
59' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
58' The corner from Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence.
57' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
54' Jurgen Klopp prepares a substitution. Curtis Jones is replaced by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).
54' Diogo Jota goes off the pitch and Luis Diaz (Liverpool) comes on.

53' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) controls a great pass from Jeremy Doku on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
52' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) takes the corner kick, but Ederson reads it well and stops the effort.

52' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
50' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
49' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
48' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) passes the ball onto Darwin Nunez, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
47' Poor challenge! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is penalised for tripping and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Ederson was alert and made a comfortable save.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

44' What a wonderful moment! Phil Foden (Manchester City) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the bottom right corner. His effort fails to surprise Alisson, who makes a nice save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
43' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
42' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
41' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
39' Manchester City keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
36' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
34' Ederson leaps to intercept the corner kick from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool).
34' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
33' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

32' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Manchester City win a corner kick.
30' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
27' 1 - 0 Goal! Nathan Ake tees up Erling Haaland (Manchester City) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
27' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) will take a corner kick.
27' The ball is cleared after Rodri (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.
26' Manchester City failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.
23' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul after Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) hacks down one of his opponents.
23' Manchester City take a short corner kick.
23' A pass from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is intercepted by Alisson and the move breaks down. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
20' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
18' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
16' Ederson pulls off a fantastic save! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
14' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
13' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland, but he puts too much power on the pass.
11' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper is there to stop it.
9' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) brought his opponent down.
7' Manchester City are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

5' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
4' Some great controlled play and passing from Liverpool. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' The referee blows his whistle as Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Manchester City will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh was nominated as the referee for this game.
